title: Uniform product measure
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set equipped with a measurable space in which every singleton is measurable, and let $m$ be a nonnegative integer. The measure associated with the uniform distribution on the set of functions from $\{1,\ldots,m\}$ to $\Omega$ equals the product, over those $m$ coordinates, of the uniform measure on $\Omega$.
